upload.title: Add a photo of the rider
upload.titleFitting: Add a photo of the fitting
upload.privacy: A photo of the rider in a base layer is personal data: it stays in the office and is deleted on its date. Its own file name is not kept.
upload.hint: JPEG or PNG, at most 15 MB.
upload.deleteOnHint: Leave it empty: deleted 90 days after the garment ships.
upload.type: A photo as JPEG or PNG (on a phone choose "Most compatible").
upload.full: At most 12 photos here: change a delete date to today first, or take them on the next revision.
upload.store: The photo did not reach the file store: try again.
upload.off: Made-to-measure has not started for this garment type: no photo is added until it starts.

delete.afterShipping: Deleted 90 days after the garment ships

date.title: Delete date of the photo: {view}
date.dayHint: From today on: today deletes the photo within the hour.
date.doneToday: The photo will be deleted within the hour.

problem.tooLate: At most two years from today.
problem.reason: Say why (at most 500 characters): it is logged.
problem.deleted: This photo is deleted already: its date stays as it is.
problem.same: The photo is deleted on that day already.
problem.stale: This photo changed meanwhile: it was read again.
problem.retained: This photo is kept at least until a later day: it is not deleted before.

problem.failed: That did not work: try again.
problem.forbidden: Your roles do not allow this.
problem.notFound: The photo or the record is no longer there.
problem.unavailable: The office server cannot be reached: try again.
problem.open: The photo could not be opened: it may be deleted or still being checked.

range.hint: The rider's newest measures against the certified range of each open unit's style

rules.title: The rules, as you type them
rules.intro: Each rule checks the measures while they are typed and sent, once made-to-measure has started. Blocks: not taken as it stands; Warns: said and kept.
rules.none: No rule: only the plausible range of each point is asked again.

means.ORDER: The point is never above the other point (both in the same unit).
means.RATIO: The point divided by the other point stays between the factors.
means.RANGE: The point's measure stays between the values, in its unit.

base.title: Base size
base.intro: The points the suggested base size is read from, in the template's order (the first ticked decides first). None: the base size is typed.
base.points: Points the base size is read from
base.tie: When two sizes fit as well

limits.title: Tolerances and alteration limits
limits.intro: Per point: the inspection tolerance of a made-to-measure garment, and how far under and over the base size's measure a unit may go before a pattern maker reviews it. Empty: not set.

held.right: Your roles do not allow this: it needs the right to manage styles and their templates.
held.archived: This template is archived: restore it first.
held.notEditable: This template is not kept by your company: its rules are changed where it is kept.
held.offline: Offline: try again when the connection is back.

problem.code: A code of 1 to 60 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, each rule once.
problem.words: The words in Italian at least (at most 500 characters each).
problem.point: A point of this template (an archived point only on a rule not checked).
problem.other: Another point of this template (for an order rule, in the same unit).
problem.factor: Factors above 0 with at most 4 decimals, the smallest not above the largest; at least one.
problem.value: Values with at most 2 decimals, the smallest not above the largest; at least one.
problem.kind: This kind of rule takes other fields: check them.
problem.limit: 0 or more, in the point's unit, at most 2 decimals.
problem.failed: The rules could not be saved: try again.
problem.stale: Someone changed the template meanwhile: the rules were read again, check them and save once more.
